filter.description: Keep only URLs containing this text

type.description: Keep only this resource type, e.g. fetch, xhr, document, script

status.description: Keep only failed requests, errors or one status class

limit.description: How many of the latest matching requests to show (default 50)

clear.description: Empty the log after reading it

description.description: A short label of what this call works on or looks for, shown to the user as its row: a noun phrase of 2 to 6 words, no leading verb
